seo.title: Services — Habit Coaching, Workshops & Corporate Sessions
seo.description: HabitRise services: the 21-day 6 AM challenge, 1:1 habit coaching, college workshops and corporate morning-routine sessions with Manikandan Rajendran. Tell us what you're interested in.

hero.title: Ways to work with HabitRise.
hero.text: From the 21-day challenge to talks for your college or team — pick what fits, and we'll get in touch.

services.title: 21-Day 6 AM Challenge
services.text: Live 6 AM sessions for 21 days, the S.A.V.E.R.S routine and the private Skool community.

services.title: Rise & Read 2027
services.text: A 21-day reading-habit challenge: 20 pages a day, one takeaway a day, one idea applied every week.

services.title: 1:1 Habit Coaching
services.text: Weekly one-to-one sessions to design your routine, fix what keeps breaking and stay on track.

services.title: College Workshops
services.text: High-energy sessions on discipline, purpose and exam-ready routines for schools and colleges.

services.title: Corporate Sessions
services.text: Morning-routine and focus programmes for teams, from a PMP-certified delivery lead.
